transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Well, I came in because I’m just so tired lately. I can barely get through a shift at work anymore. It feels like my body is filled with wet sand, and... resting doesn't really bring me back. I just can't seem to shake it.
Have you been feeling down or depressed?

I wouldn't really say I feel depressed. Like, I'm not sad or crying or anything. I'm just... completely wiped out. It's more that I just don't have the energy to do much of anything, rather than feeling down.
When you sleep, do you wake up feeling refreshed?

Not really, no. My sleep has been pretty messed up for a while. With the changing shifts at the store, I got to a point where I’d only sleep a few hours and still feel completely wired. But now... I mean, even when I’m just so exhausted, I still wake up really early and my mind is already going. So I definitely don't wake up feeling refreshed.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I guess I have. Things I usually love doing... like cooking for myself, playing guitar, going hiking, or even just heading over to my family's place... they all just feel really flat right now. It's like I'm only pretending to care about them.
Even if you haven’t felt sad exactly, have you been feeling hopeless?

No, I don't think so. I wouldn't say hopeless. It's not like I feel like things are never going to get better or that there's no point to anything. I'm just... really drained right now. So, no, not hopeless.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
No, not really. I mean, I know I said I'm drained, but I can still focus on things okay. Like at work, ringing people up... I don't really lose my place or anything. So my concentration seems fine.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious or worried a lot lately?
No, not really. I mean, I'm not any more worried than usual. I don't feel that tight, anxious feeling in my chest or anything like that. Just... tired, mostly. But not anxious.
Have you been moving or speaking more slowly than usual lately?

Yeah, I have. It's been a bit of a shift. At first, I couldn't stop pacing around the store and straightening things up all the time. But lately... yeah, even just walking to the bus or answering a question feels really slowed down. It's like everything just feels heavy right now.
Even if you haven’t felt hopeless, have you been feeling down or low in yourself most days lately?
No, I don't think so. I haven't really felt down or sad like that. Just... physically drained and slow, like I mentioned. But my mood itself hasn't been low or depressed.
Have you been feeling unusually sensitive to cold lately?
No, I don't think so. I haven't noticed feeling any colder than anyone else around me. Just the normal amount for the weather, really.
Have you had a period recently where you felt unusually high, energized, or euphoric?

Yeah, actually. For a while there, I felt... I don't know, almost unstoppable? Like I was just extra cheerful and had all this energy. But then, out of nowhere, I'd just snap hard over really small things. Like if someone at work asked me to count a drawer again, I'd just get so irritated. So yeah, I was feeling really high and energized, but also pretty on edge.
During that high-energy period, did you need less sleep than usual and still feel rested?

Yeah. With the changing shifts, I got to where I’d sleep only a few hours and still feel completely wired. Like I didn't even need the rest. And now... even when I’m just exhausted, I still wake up early with my mind already going.
During that energized period, did you feel more confident or capable than usual?

Not really, no. I mean... I didn't feel like I was suddenly smarter or better at things. I was just moving really fast. I didn't feel extra confident or anything, just really wired and, like I said, kind of snappy. So, no, I wouldn't say I felt more capable than usual, just energized.
During that unusually energized period, did it cause major problems in your life or at work?

Yeah, it did. I mean, at work, I started making mistakes on the register. I was falling behind on the cash-office tasks, and... well, my manager actually took me off some of the responsibilities I was doing. I was really hoping those would help me get promoted, so that sucked. And outside of work, I've just been avoiding my family. It got bad enough that I actually needed same-day crisis help because... I just didn't feel safe trying to handle it all by myself.
Lately, have you been feeling depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
No, not really. I mean, I've been exhausted and kind of stressed out with everything going on, but I wouldn't say I've been feeling down or depressed like that. Just... tired and overwhelmed, mostly.
Have you had thoughts of killing yourself?

Yeah, I have. I've had some scary thoughts lately... like maybe everyone would just be better off if I didn't wake up. And a few times on the way home, I actually caught myself thinking about just stepping off the curb right into traffic. So, yes.
Right now, do you feel sad or depressed most of the day?
No, not really. Like I said before, I wouldn't say I feel sad or depressed. Just really overwhelmed and worn out by everything.
